content:
The Mexican duo Sin Bandera is bringing its "Escenas Tour" to Laredo on Saturday, November 7, with a concert at the Sames Auto Arena, according to Notistarz.

The duo — Noel Schajris and Leonel García — plays the Payne Arena in Hidalgo on Friday, November 6, before heading to Laredo for the Saturday show.

The tour celebrates 26 years of the duo's career. The show pairs some of Sin Bandera's best-known songs with material from its latest album, "Escenas."

Sin Bandera arrives in Texas after a run of U.S. dates that included a sold-out show at the United Palace in New York and a recent concert at the James L. Knight Center in Miami.

After Texas, the tour continues in California on December 1 and in Las Vegas on December 4, wrapping the 2026 run on December 6 in Sacramento.

Sources: Notistarz, Nov. 5, 2026.
